title: Vectors and Vector Spaces
description: Introduction to vectors, operations, linear independence, basis and dimension.

concepts.title: Vector Basics
concepts.explanation: A vector is an object that has both magnitude and direction. In linear algebra, we represent them as ordered lists of numbers.

exercise.question: What is the result of adding [1,2] and [3,4]?

concepts.title: Dot Product
concepts.explanation: The dot product measures how much two vectors point in the same direction.
